subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should the first public account/publisher feed contract preserve existing personal-publisher legacy fallbacks before merge, or is ownerPublisherId-only feed behavior an intentional first-slice limitation?
rationale: This is a public API compatibility boundary: current main still supports linked-user and ownerUserId legacy reads, while this PR would expose a narrower feed contract unless maintainers explicitly accept that limitation.

options.title: Preserve legacy personal publishers
options.body: Require the feed implementation to reuse existing linked-user and ownerUserId fallback behavior, add regression tests, and require live HTTP/Convex proof before merge.

options.title: Accept ownerPublisherId-only feeds
options.body: Ship the narrower first slice intentionally, but document that some legacy personal content can be absent until migration completes.

options.title: Pause for feed-stack review
options.body: Hold this PR until the adjacent account feed, registry bridge, publisher state, and follow/feed stack direction is confirmed together.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy personal publishers
recommendation.body: Require the feed implementation to reuse existing linked-user and ownerUserId fallback behavior, add regression tests, and require live HTTP/Convex proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the current personal-publisher compatibility paths and recent feed/schema history most directly affected by the decision.
